results.content:
I operate Mazaraat Artisan Cheese as an artisanal natural cheese maker, an organic, raw milk cheese dairy in Yogyakarta region

Applying a holistic, organic management approach to the health of cows and goats comes naturally

Ours aged and fresh cheeses have been recognized by Indonesian culinary experts, and we travel nationwide to present workshops on cheesemaking, tasting, pairing and cooking

As a traditional cheesemaker, I believe that traditional cheesemaking is not [...] Mazaraat Cheese today continues the respected tradition of natural cheese making by hand

Each on Mazaraat production’s day, they started the day at dawn, picking up fresh milk from Merapi Mountain, where a small group of local farmers determined and willing to raise their cattle in most natural and organic way

Our local farmers will assure all the cattle are grass-feed and do not involve with any kind of pesticide for the grass nor antibiotic and any chemical treatment for the [...] treatment for the cattle

Mazaraat Cheese take a great pride in getting their fresh product out the door and to your table as quickly as possible to ensure that it is always at its freshest with peak flavour and texture

Applying a holistic, organic management approach to the health of cows and goats comes naturally

Ours aged and fresh cheeses have been recognized by Indonesian culinary experts, and we travel nationwide to present workshops on cheesemaking, tasting, pairing and cooking

As a traditional cheesemaker, I believe that traditional cheesemaking is not [...] cheesemaking is not simply about food or even about gastronomic delight, but rather carries with it the weight of the culture and local identity that are so essential for providing context and meaning to our lives

What sets our sustainable cheese business apart from others is the love and care with which we handcraft in every batch of cheese

Cheeses from Mazaraat contain no preservatives, additives, artificial flavor, chemical food coloring or GMO ingredients

results.title: Mazaraat Cheese: A Story of an Indonesian Artisanal Cheese Producer - NOW! Jakarta
results.content: Although cheese remains a less common food in Indonesia, the founders of Yogyakarta-based Mazaraat Artisan Cheese, Muhammad Najmi (also known as Jamie) and Nieta Pricilia Puspitasari, share their journey of how cheese became a significant part of their family. In 2011, facing their daughter’s diagnosis of a leaky heart at just 1.5 months old, the couple embarked on a journey to learn and create their own fermented foods and beverages. Opting for a natural approach to care for their daughter, [...] Aiming for sustainability and growth, Mazaraat is not merely a cheese story anymore but an upstream/downstream ecosystem, encompassing animal feed farmers, cattle and dairy goat farmers, cheese processing, distribution traders, and logistics. Highlighting the integral role of good milk, Jamie emphasises their commitment to the nutritional needs of Indonesian children, promoting natural cheese, derived 100% from Indonesian soil and cultivated by Indonesian farmers. [...] Unlike France, Italy, the Netherlands, or even England, Indonesia may not be the first place that comes to mind when thinking of cheese excellence. However, that perception is about to change, thanks to Mazaraat Cheese. Founded by the visionary duo of Muhammad Najmi and Nieta Pricilia Puspitasari, Mazaraat is making waves in the world of cheese, impressing global experts and renowned chefs with its artisanal offerings.
